create_spectrogram_from_audio_tensor: create a spectrogram from an audio tensor using STFT with a configurable FFT size and hop length
reconstruct_audio_from_spectrogram: reconstruct an audio signal from a complex spectrogram tensor using inverse STFT
test_spectro_ispectro_roundtrip: test that spectro and ispectro produce a lossless roundtrip on a PyTorch audio tensor
refactor_spectro_for_custom_window: refactor the spectro function to accept a custom window function instead of the default Hann window
review_ispectro_pad_parameter: review the ispectro function and how the pad parameter affects the inverse STFT window length
